items.headline:
BREAKING: August PPI Inflation rises to 5.4%, above expectations of 5.3%.

Core PPI Inflation rose to 4.6%, the highest since June 2026.

July's headline and core PPI inflation numbers were also revised higher.

The odds of rate hikes are rising further on the news.

BREAKING: The European Central Bank officially hikes rates by 25 basis points, marking its second rate hike this year as rising oil prices drive up inflation.

Markets also now see a 90% chance of a third interest rate hike by the ECB this year.
